# lakekeeper_tag_definition (Resource)

The `lakekeeper_tag_definition` resource manages a governance tag definition in a Lakekeeper project.

~> **Preview:** Governance tags are a **preview** feature in Lakekeeper and may change in future releases.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/tag)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lakekeeper_tag_definition" "pii" {
  project_id     = "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0"
  name           = "pii.classification"
  description    = "PII sensitivity classification"
  scope          = ["table", "column"]
  value_kind     = "enumerated"
  allowed_values = ["low", "high"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the tag definition. `.` is the hierarchy delimiter (for example `pii.classification`). Unique within the project, case-insensitively.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the tag definition belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `scope` (Set of String) Target types this tag definition may be applied to. Valid values: `warehouse`, `namespace`, `table`, `view`, `generic-table`, `column`. Existing scopes cannot be removed on update.
- `value_kind` (String) How values of this tag definition are constrained: `marker`, `free-text`, or `enumerated`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `allowed_values` (Set of String) Permitted values for an `enumerated` tag definition. Required and non-empty when `value_kind` is `enumerated`; must be omitted otherwise. Existing values cannot be removed on update.
- `description` (String) The description of the tag definition.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag definition was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the tag definition, in the form `{{project_id}}/{{tag_definition_id}}`.
- `tag_definition_id` (String) The UUID of the tag definition.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag definition was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# id is "{{project_id}}/{{tag_definition_id}}"
terraform import lakekeeper_tag_definition.pii "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0/37cf8760-5092-4d5d-8b29-a6b46a45f067"
```
